locator: I q.11 a.3 co., third proof: Quae autem diversa sunt, in unum ordinem non convenirent, nisi ab aliquo uno ordinarentur
interpretation: Total analyst reading, taking the sentence with its surroundings (Omnia enim quae sunt ... ; primum reducens omnia in unum ordinem): one event has a finite exercised path to all. Finite ancestry is the analyst's choice for reducens; the source does not state it. On this reading at most one exercised source follows at once, so it adds no independent step toward that conclusion.
